Graduate Degree Programs
Lehigh University offers nationally recognized, research-based Ph.D. programs and professional master’s degree and certificate programs. Through an expansive offering of graduate degree programs, graduate studies at Lehigh produces driven and highly accomplished alumni with a demonstrable track record of success in industry and academia.
